units.meaning: If an employer does not maintain an accurate record of hours worked by an employee, including employees who are exempt from FLSA's recordkeeping requirements for hours worked (e.g., bona fide executive, administrative, and professional employees as defined in FLSA Regulations, 29 CFR part 541), the employer bears the burden of showing that the employee has not worked the requisite hours.

In order to claim that full-time teachers (as defined in § 825.102) of an elementary or secondary school system, an institution of higher education, or another educational establishment or institution (who often work outside the classroom or at their homes) are not eligible for FMLA leave, an employer must be able to clearly demonstrate that they did not work 1,250 hours during the previous 12 months.

Provides a cross-reference directing readers to § 825.801(d) for special rules applicable to airline flight crew employees, without establishing an independent substantive requirement in this passage.
